shortDescription: Thailand expects electricity demand to grow at the fastest pace since at least 2018, driven by industrial activity including electronics production amid a global boom in artificial intelligence and data-center investment, according to Bloomberg.

title: Thailand Power Demand Growth Seen at Nine-Year High on AI-Driven Industrial Activity
